toc.title: Sermo primus. Sermo apologeticus de dignitate Eucharistiae, Ioanne Oecolampadio authore, in die S. Thomae, lecto Euangelio Ioannis 21.
Sermo secundus. In vigilia natalis Ioan. Oecolamp. authore.

book: A 1575 Zurich edition of two Latin apologetic sermons by Johannes Oecolampadius on the dignity of the Eucharist, each sermon a single undivided text, with a title page at the front and a printer's address to the reader at the back.
